abstract: PURPOSE: To determine the value of color Doppler ultrasonography (CDUS) as a routine investigational method for diagnosis of scrotal pathologies. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This prospective observational study (case series) was carried out over a period of 16 months on 122 patients in the age range of 13 to 70 years old, who presented with scrotal swellings. After adequate history taking and examination, CDUS was performed. The diagnosis of the surgeon and that of radiologist were compared with final outcome, which was based on course and outcome of the disease, fine needle aspiration cytology results, and operative findings. RESULTS: The final diagnoses were epididymitis or epididymo-orchitis (46), hydrocele (26), varicocele (16), testicular malignancy (16), orchitis (6), testicular torsion (4), spermatic cord injury (2), hematocele (2), and pyocele (2). Color Doppler ultrasonography accurately diagnosed all cases of epididymitis or epididymo-orchitis, spermatic cord injury, testicular torsion, varicocele, and hydrocele (sensitivity 100% and specificity 100%). Of 16 subjects diagnosed as testicular malignancy on CDUS, only 14 were subsequently found to have malignancy. Two cases of orchitis were wrongly diagnosed as malignancy. Similarly, of 6 patients diagnosed as orchitis, 1 was found to have seminoma (sensitivity 87.5% and specificity 66.7%). Overall sensitivity of CDUS in diagnosing scrotal diseases was 98% while specificity was 66.7%. CONCLUSION: Color Doppler ultrasonography is an excellent, a safe, and reliable method for evaluating patients with scrotal diseases. It aids in diagnosis of testicular tumors and reduces the number of unnecessary exploratory operations. It is especially important in conditions like testicular torsion where immediate diagnosis is required.

目的：陰嚢疾患の診断における日常的な検査法としてのカラードプラ超音波検査（CDUS）の有用性を明らかにする。
材料と方法：陰嚢腫脹を呈した13〜70歳の122例を対象に、16か月間にわたり前向き観察研究（症例集積）を実施した。十分な問診と診察の後、CDUSを施行した。外科医と放射線科医の診断を、経過、転帰、穿刺吸引細胞診の結果、手術所見に基づく最終転帰と比較した。
結果：最終診断は、副睾丸炎または副睾丸精巣炎（46例）、水瘤（26例）、精索静脈瘤（16例）、精巣悪性腫瘍（16例）、精巣炎（6例）、精巣捻転症（4例）、精索損傷（2例）、血瘤（2例）、膿瘤（2例）であった。CDUSは副睾丸炎または副睾丸精巣炎、精索損傷、精巣捻転症、精索静脈瘤、水瘤のすべての症例を正確に診断した（感度100%、特異度100%）。CDUSで精巣悪性腫瘍と診断された16例のうち、その後悪性腫瘍と確認されたのは14例であった。精巣炎と診断された2例は、誤って悪性腫瘍と診断された。同様に、精巣炎と診断された6例のうち1例がセミノーマと判明した（感度87.5%、特異度66.7%）。CDUSによる陰嚢疾患の診断全体の感度は98%、特異度は66.7%であった。
結論：カラードプラ超音波検査は陰嚢疾患患者の評価において優れた、安全かつ信頼性の高い方法である。精巣腫瘍の診断に役立ち、不必要な探索的手術の数を減らす。即時の診断が必要な精巣捻転症のような状態では特に重要である。
